subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

The aboriginal tribes of Australia are of a low-class black race, but generally pieceful and inoffensive in their habits.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pieceful"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling should be **"peaceful"** which means free from disturbance; tranquil. (शांतिपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The village was a** peaceful **haven away from the hustle and bustle of the city.
 
 
 
• **"Peaceful"** refers to a state of tranquility or quietness. (शांतिपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoys a **peaceful **walk in the park every morning.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inoffensive** (अनअपमानजनक): Not causing any harm or offense.

 
 
• **Example:** His inoffensive remarks were appreciated by everyone.
 
 
 
• **Aboriginal** (आदिवासी): Relating to the original people living in a place, especially in Australia.
 
 
• **Example:** The aboriginal tribes have a rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Their** (उनका): Belonging to or associated with the people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.
 
 
• **Example:** Their house is at the end of the street.
 
 

33:T9c7,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
